label: NOTE: what this set reaches, and what it deliberately cannot
why: The ten V92Modulator members that drive an already-built transmit graph, read out of .text+0x14450..+0x14c19 and +0x15060..+0x1511a. Every entry below is a claim the disassembly makes: the branchless non-zero test in getV92TxFilterDelay, the six arguments enterPhase3 hands the phase 3 modulator, the four state codes the four exits guard on and the four different callees they reach, exitCPt's guard on a DIFFERENT sub-object, enterDataPhase's ungated channel and its block size, reset's twelve writes and its priming loop, and mkResampledSignal's split, its dispatch, its wrap and its two join loops. WHAT NO ENTRY HERE CAN REACH: the `switch` versus an `if (code == 2) ... else ...` on `resamplerPhaseChange`. The two differ only for codes outside {0, 1, 2}, `progress` is the only writer and writes only 1 and 2, and the fixture drives 3 -- so the trial exists and the MUTATION would be caught, but the reading is licensed by the object's `cmp $0x2; je; dec; je` fall-through and not by any behaviour the blob can be asked about. Nor the ORDER of reset's five clears against each other, which no observer between them can see. Finding 5900.
